Canonical evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirbydata.c#L103-L243.

Foreign definitions corroborate the resource-field interpretation: ftKirby_CopyName contains filename and name, Fighter_CostumeStrings contains dat_filename, joint_name, and matanim_joint_name, and Fighter_DemoStrings supplies the four stated demo fields. This establishes source-level member meaning, not compiled layout. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirby.h#L17-L20; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/types.h#L894-L905.

Inspected active foreign consumers independently. Archive filenames and symbol names are used by the loader; costume NULL guards apply only to the costume branch, while archive and effect operations are separate. Effect-array entries are passed to efAsync_LoadAsync and efAsync_LoadSync. The proposal explicitly preserves these distinctions. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirby.c#L2738-L2798.

The functionality synthesis accurately covers boundary and optional branches: selector 0xFF uses a zero-based loop bounded by arg2, other costume selectors use arg1 through arg1 + 1 exclusive, kind -1 and 4 are skipped by the synchronous consumer, and the optional absent material-animation-name branch clears the corresponding cache pointer. General bounds validity is not asserted. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirby.c#L2738-L2798.

The demo-selector warning and effect-sentinel uncertainty are justified. Only demo selectors 11 and 14 initialize the local offset. The async comparison uses plain char, and efAsync_LoadSync forms an indexed pointer before its 0–49 range guard. The synthesis does not incorrectly promote these observations into portable safety guarantees. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirby.c#L2721-L2734; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirby.c#L2761-L2797; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efasync.c#L1287-L1316.

Both proposed writes target only the owned translation-unit entity. No inferred aliases, numeric gameplay mappings, section-layout facts, foreign-subject writes, new links, entities, merges, or follow-ups are proposed. Static resource storage is distinguished from consumer-managed loaded caches, and callback registration is not treated as proof of lifetime policy. Exceptional floating-point behavior is inapplicable to this data-only source.
unresolved: The .data identity and reported address do not establish compiled section membership, size, ordering, alignment, or object layout. No such fact is proposed or accepted as proved.
The exact FTKIND_MAX definition and compiled ABI layout remain unverified in this review. Reported counts for FTKIND_MAX-sized arrays describe explicit initializers.

Target plain-char signedness and resulting exclusion of the unsigned-byte sentinel in the async caller remain unproved. The synchronous effect loader's range check does not establish portable safety of its earlier out-of-range pointer formation.
Universal upstream kind and costume bounds enforcement remains unproved. Six-entry costume tables require valid indices 0–5, and unsupported demo selectors have no established safe fallback.
Archive contents, visual equivalence of shared Gw resources, and precise gameplay meanings of resource suffixes or numeric effect indices remain unproved.

Loaded-cache destruction, asynchronous request ownership and lifetime, and registered loader callback retention, invocation timing, and teardown remain unestablished. Registration itself is visible at code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftKirby/ftkirby.c#L2800-L2803.
